title: spec: PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio'] lists delete_package, with chatbot.tool.delete_package labels in every ui locale (blocks cloud#3656)
body:
repo:cloud#3 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjRhUZjdy8VXs6Kkur2

Filing gate: **(b) a contract gap with a named consumer**. objectstack-ai/cloud#3656's PR #3686 adds the `delete_package` build tool, which only ever stages a person-confirmed removal. Cloud's `platform-tool-names-conformance.test.ts` is red on it until the framework registry lists the tool. Precedent: #27002 and eca7cd2008 (cloud#3565's record-write tool). Lane: `domain:cloud`.

## 维护者速读

cloud 给 AI 和 MCP 加了一个「删除环境里搭的应用」的工具（只发起删除，由人确认）。平台有一张「平台工具名单」，cloud 的测试要求每个工具都登记在册、并且每种语言都有显示名。这张卡在名单里加上 `delete_package`，补上各语言的显示名。

## Expected

- `packages/spec/src/system/constants/platform-tool-names.ts`: add `delete_package` to `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE['service-ai-studio']`.
- `chatbot.tool.delete_package` labels in every `ui/packages/i18n` locale pack, following the existing tool-label pattern and gates (`check:i18n`).
- Whatever spec conformance tests pin the list.

## Acceptance

- Spec tests and i18n gates green. Cloud's conformance test turns green once the cloud pin moves past this card.

Suggested-grade: p1 (blocks a p1).

Dedupe (2026-11-06): `PLATFORM_TOOLS_BY_PACKAGE` → #27002, #16512 (closed, other tools). None for delete_package.
